Team — forwarding Alicia's note. Short version: assessor couldn't locate evidence for four controls. I started a traceback and pulled what we already have into a reference index (see attached csv). Action items below; please read and reply with ETA.

Summary of items I couldn't fully validate in the package:
- CCM-01 / identity lifecycle: missing formal deprovisioning runbook and a sample ticket proving automated termination (we have SSOs configured but not the ticket/exec proof).
- IAM-02 / privileged access reviews: we have quarterly PAM reports but no signed reviewer attestations in the bundle.
- DS-04 / backup verification logs: backups exist but the recent restore verification logs (Aug–Sep) aren't attached.
- SEF-03 / security event correlation: we have SIEM dashboards/screenshots but need an evidence artifact showing correlation rule test results or SOC runbook snapshots.

Proposed owners & asks (please confirm):
- Dylan: take CCM-01 + DS-04 — collect deprovisioning runbook, ticket examples, and Aug–Sep backup verification logs. Attach to the evidence index and point to ticket ids.
- Karthik: own IAM-02 — pull PAM reviewer attestations or coordinate with People Ops (if attestation missing, draft temporary reviewer statements).
- Marissa: own SEF-03 — export correlation test results or capture runbook snapshots and escalate to SRE if we need a replay.

Deadlines: internal drafts by 2026-10-12 EOD PDT, consolidated package ready for Aurora by 2026-10-13 AM so they can confirm before auditor scheduling. If any item cannot meet these dates, state the blocker and proposed remediation date.

Attachments: caiq_evidence_index.csv (index of what we've already got / gaps).

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks for the flag. Per our traceback, we located or produced the missing artifacts and assembled a consolidated response package. High level:
- CCM-01 (identity lifecycle): included redacted ticket TKT-4921 showing automated deprovisioning audit trail + deprovisioning runbook excerpt (Identity repo).
- IAM-02 (privileged access reviews): added signed reviewer attestations for Q2/Q3 2026; if Aurora needs a different format, tell us and we can adapt.
- DS-04 (backup verification): attached verification logs for Aug–Sep and runbook snapshot showing restore verification cadence.
- SEF-03 (security event correlation): exported correlation-rule test output and a runbook snapshot; SRE validated replay on 2026-10-11 and provided a short test log.

I've uploaded the package to this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-aurora-caiq-response and attached a zipped bundle for convenience (Aurora_CAIQ_Response_v1.zip). The attachment contains a manifest and the caiq_evidence_index.csv that maps each control to file names and ticket ids.

If you or the auditor need additional context for any item, happy to schedule a 30-minute walkthrough — propose 2026-10-14 10:00 AM PDT. Please confirm.

Best regards,
